fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition held a national validation workshop on 17 June 2026 at the Virtual University of Burkina Faso where stakeholders from government, the private sector, academia, civil society organisations and technical partners reviewed the draft National AI Roadmap 2026-2030.

The Ministry of Digital Transition, through SPIVTEN, opened a national situational-analysis workshop on 27 August 2025 for the national AI action plan, bringing together public institutions, the private sector, universities, research centres, civil society and technical and financial partners in thematic sub-groups whose conclusions feed the draft plan.
